scope: Read-only contract/edge-case review before production patch. Existing pure subtitle formatter functions executed only on synthetic timing records; retained actual native word evidence inspected. No app import, model calls, audio inference, criteria change or Git edit.
authoritative_duration: N complete decoded float32 mono samples /16000; original media-container duration and rounded segment metadata are not authoritative.
segment_contract: Validate finite native numbers with0<=start<end before applying any endpoint correction. NaN/Infinity, negative start and reversed/nonpositive intervals are invalid; do not repair them by clamping.
Reject start>=decoded_duration, because no positive in-audio interval can retain that start.

For valid start<duration, cap only an overlong end at exact decoded duration; preserve original text, segment sequence and native decoder/settings. Do not drop, sort, merge or shorten text to make timing pass.
Validate the final returned interval again after any existing presentation rounding. Round-trip subtitle formatting must not place its end beyond physical audio.

A valid source interval below one millisecond cannot always be encoded as a positive millisecond interval without moving a boundary. Preserve precision internally and handle unrepresentable export explicitly; do not fabricate a minimum duration.

concrete_export_findings.violation: _render_subtitles forces start+0.1, exporting6.600 instead of bounded6.540.
concrete_export_findings.fix_requirement: Remove invented minimum duration for otherwise valid segments, and preserve actual bounded endpoints in subtitles.
Account for final millisecond conversion. N//16 is an exact integer floor for the last in-audio millisecond at16kHz; a second nearest rounding of exact duration can overrun.

optional_word_contract: The native engine demonstrably emits zero-duration word observations. Existing _word_speaker_alignment rejects those as unusable alignment while retaining the whole segment text and warning; do not turn this into a new whole-transcript failure.

Apply physical bounds only when the observed word interval remains finite and genuinely positive after capping. Do not shift word starts, create duration, discard individual word strings or manufacture alignment.
For unusable optional word timing, preserve whole-segment text and the existing conservative speaker fallback; retain raw evidence in QA. Do not label invalid timing as verified word alignment.

Existing parent containment tolerance0.05s, order tolerance0.001s, positive-duration and exact joined-word-text checks already govern whether words may split a segment. Additional parent clamping or new fatal containment rules are unnecessary for the physical audio-end fix and would change behavior.
error_handling: Timestamp-specific ReadableError raised inside the current broad recognition try will be rewrapped by except Exception unless explicitly re-raised before the generic decoding-error handler.
historical_experiment_contract: Keep the already-run large-v3 helper, source-policy JSON, workflow, plan, outputs and frozen manifest unchanged. They describe commit73b75b45 and the original recognizer AST, including the observed overrun.

Historical positive non-model validation may reconstruct only the old _recognize function and literal constants from frozen production-policy.json inside a temporary copied source view. Label this as a reconstructed function view, not byte-identical historical full app.py.

Patch both the helper ROOT and shared common.ROOT for temporary validation because repo_file closes over the latter. Exact plan-bound files must still be copied and hashed; symlink escape should not weaken path safety.

Retain explicit negative validation that the old plan rejects the changed current recognizer or a deliberately changed AST. Do not suppress/relax the original policy fingerprint gate to keep tests green.
Archive original test bytes and changed-test rationale in the new timing-fix evidence directory. Do not rewrite historical experiment evidence.
Any later hosted test of the new physical-boundary policy needs a distinct plan/source identity and must not be described as the earlier73b75b45 experiment.
recommended_bounded_cases: Observed native[0,7.0] against6.54s decoded audio -> same text/start, end6.54.
Final positive[6.50,6.54] -> subtitle end no later than6.54; no100ms extension.
N104649 -> end remains<=6.5405625 after final millisecond formatting.
Start exactly at/beyond duration -> clear invalid-timing outcome, no shifted start.
NaN/Infinity/negative/reversed segment times -> reject before clipping.
Positive sub-ms interval -> no rounded zero/reversed internal result and no fabricated subtitle interval.
Actual zero-duration word evidence -> whole-segment text fallback, no new whole-job failure.
Valid wordend beyond audio -> cap if still positive; unusable results preserve conservative whole-segment fallback.
Unchanged valid in-audio segment/word data and decoder kwargs remain unchanged.
